chemistry-m1-q2.title: N'okpomọkụ edoziri, a mụbara
chemistry-m1-q2.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-m1-q2.material: N'okpomọkụ edoziri, a mụbara nrụgide nke gas nke oke ya bụ 60 mL na 1 atm ruo 3 atm. Kedu oke gas a dị dịka iwu Boyle?
chemistry-m1-q2.s.s1.prompt: N'okpomọkụ edoziri, a mụbara nrụgide nke gas nke oke ya bụ 60 mL na 1 atm ruo 3 atm. Kedu oke gas a dị dịka iwu Boyle?

chemistry-m1-c.title: [Ọsọ mgbasa miri emi]
chemistry-m1-c.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-m1-c.material: [Ọsọ mgbasa miri emi] E tinyere owu a gbanyere na ammonia mmiri siri ike (molecular mass 17) na owu a gbanyere na hydrochloric acid siri ike (molecular mass 36.5) n'otu oge n'ọnụ abụọ nke ogologo ọkpọkọ gilaasị ma kpuchie ha na rọba. Nwa oge ka e mesịrị, mgbe eriri anwụrụ ọcha (ammonium chloride) pụtara n'ime ọkpọkọ, kedu ebe ọ dị nso?
chemistry-m1-c.s.s1.prompt: [Ọsọ mgbasa miri emi] E tinyere owu a gbanyere na ammonia mmiri siri ike (molecular mass 17) na owu a gbanyere na hydrochloric acid siri ike (molecular mass 36.5) n'otu oge n'ọnụ abụọ nke ogologo ọkpọkọ gilaasị ma kpuchie ha na rọba. Nwa oge ka e mesịrị, mgbe eriri anwụrụ ọcha (ammonium chloride) pụtara n'ime ọkpọkọ, kedu ebe ọ dị nso?
chemistry-m1-c.s.s1.explain: Ọsọ mgbasa nke gas bụ inverse nke square root nke molecular mass. Ammonia gas dị mfe (molecular mass 17) na-aga ngwa ngwa karịa hydrogen chloride gas dị arọ (36.5), ya mere ha na-emeghachi omume n'ebe ọ dị nso karịa owu hydrochloric acid, nke na-aga nwayọ, ma eriri anwụrụ ọcha na-apụta.

chemistry-killer-07.title: N'ọnọdụ ọkọlọtọ (STP, 0
chemistry-killer-07.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-killer-07.material: N'ọnọdụ ọkọlọtọ (STP, 0 °C, 1 atm; 1 mol nke gas = 22.4 L), olu ngwakọta gas nke methane ($\mathrm{CH_4}$) na carbon dioxide ($\mathrm{CO_2}$) bụ 11.2 L ma oke ya bụ 16.4 g. Oke atọm bụ H=1, C=12, O=16, ma Avogadro's number bụ $N_A$. Kedu ngụkọta ọnụọgụ atọm niile dị n'ime ngwakọta gas a?
chemistry-killer-07.s.s1.prompt: N'ọnọdụ ọkọlọtọ (STP, 0 °C, 1 atm; 1 mol nke gas = 22.4 L), olu ngwakọta gas nke methane ($\mathrm{CH_4}$) na carbon dioxide ($\mathrm{CO_2}$) bụ 11.2 L ma oke ya bụ 16.4 g. Oke atọm bụ H=1, C=12, O=16, ma Avogadro's number bụ $N_A$. Kedu ngụkọta ọnụọgụ atọm niile dị n'ime ngwakọta gas a?
chemistry-killer-07.s.s1.explain:
Nzọụkwụ 1: Ngụkọta mole = 11.2 L ÷ 22.4 L/mol = 0.5 mol → x + y = 0.5.
Nzọụkwụ 2: Oke: 16x + 44y = 16.4. Tinye y = 0.5 − x: 16x + 22 − 44x = 16.4 → 28x = 5.6 → x = 0.2, y = 0.3.
Nzọụkwụ 3: Ọnụọgụ atọm: $\mathrm{CH_4}$ nwere atọm 5 kwa molecule → 0.2 × 5 = 1.0 mol, $\mathrm{CO_2}$ nwere atọm 3 kwa molecule → 0.3 × 3 = 0.9 mol. Ngụkọta 1.9 mol nke atọm = $1.9\,N_A$.
Azịza: $1.9\,N_A$ (c). (Azịza ezighi ezi: 1.5 weere na ha niile bụ CO2, 2.5 weere na ha niile bụ CH4, 1.7 gụrụ naanị atọm H anọ nke CH4)
chemistry-killer-07.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
chemistry-killer-07.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
